sql:
SELECT size_class, count(*) AS orders FROM (
  SELECT orderkey, CASE WHEN sum(quantity) > 300 THEN 'крупный (> 300)'
                        WHEN sum(quantity) > 200 THEN 'большой (201–300)'
                        ELSE 'обычный (≤ 200)' END AS size_class
  FROM lake.bronze.lineitem GROUP BY orderkey) t
GROUP BY size_class ORDER BY orders DESC
